title: Payment of Missed-Visit Fees on an Appointment Series
content:
Patient financial policy clause on how missed-visit fees on an Appointment Series are paid and applied.

**Clause.** A missed-visit fee is paid by card, cash or check; it is never paid with an HSA or FSA card where the format does not accept one for missed-visit fees, because a missed appointment is not a medical expense. A fee is due the format's fee due period in calendar days after it is assessed. A payment is applied to the fee the patient names, otherwise to the oldest unpaid fee, and never exceeds that fee.

**The balance.** The missed-visit fee balance of a series is the late-cancellation and no-show fees owed on the series that have not been paid or waived. A negative balance is a paid fee awaiting refund.

**Condition — judgement — result.**

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Patient names the fee being paid | named fee identified | payment applied to that fee |
| Patient names no fee | oldest unpaid fee identified | payment applied to the oldest unpaid fee |
| Payment offered by HSA or FSA card, format does not accept it | method not allowed | not taken as payment of the fee |
| Payment offered by card, cash or check | method allowed | applied as above |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A series carries two unpaid fees, USD 35.00 assessed in May and USD 50.00 assessed in June. A payment made without naming a fee is applied to the May fee and does not exceed USD 35.00.
